from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper from the collection with its citation relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper from the collection")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that cite this paper in their bibliographies")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
